title: Pokus documentation page front matter
description: Front matter required on every documentation page (Pokus Documentation Specification, A.2 and A.4). Dates are ISO 8601 calendar dates (UTC).

title.description: What the reader achieves or learns on this page.

type.description: Diataxis page type; every page has exactly one.

audience.description: Readers the page is written for.

applies_to.description: Component versions the page applies to, as PEP 440 version specifiers.

last_verified.description: Last verification run of this page. All three fields are null until a verification run has executed the page; values are never fabricated.

description.description: Optional one-sentence summary used by search and link previews.

hide.description: Optional Material for MkDocs page layout switches.
